notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!
[/b]
We've been incredibly lucky to receive valuable feedback from streamers, playtesters, and players like you. Thanks to your insights, we've been able to identify bugs and areas where our game design wasn’t as clear as we thought. We've made lots of improvements!

This latest demo update includes many visual and technical fixes, as well as new mechanics, like using tools such as the axe and fire extinguisher.

This will likely be the final version of the demo before we launch the full game in a few months. The full version will feature:
- 4 to 5 hours of gameplay
- 30+ handcrafted levels
- New biomes, tools, mechanics, and dialogs to explore

As always, thank you so much for your support, your feedback, and your time. It means a lot to us.

Have a great day!
And feel free to whisilist the game, if you might be interested in it. It helps us a lot.

Florian

notes.title: Patchnote DEMO v0.7.9.2
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to share their feedback!
We've made many fixes and important additions. There are still a few details left to polish before finalizing a clean version for the DEMO, after which we'll resume development for the game's main release.

A new version of the demo is now available, featuring several fixes and improvements:

🔧 Fixes:
- Revamped the interaction system to prevent the player from interacting with multiple elements at once (dialogs/objects...).
- Fixed elements that incorrectly displayed as liftable when they weren’t.
- Fixed a bug in the menu that prevented changing options.
- Fixed settings not being applied in the menu.
- Fixed a level design issue in an underground level that made it impossible to complete.
- Fixed animation freezes when transitioning from water to a ladder.
- Improved the secret chase level with the pyromaniac.

✅ Additions:
- Added more "juice" to the chase level (camera shake, jumpscares, zoom in/out, speed VFX...).
- Added water reflection effects.
- Added 4 new languages (Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese) and their translations.
- Added new Steam achievements.

🛠 What we're currently working on:
- Adding new objects for the new biomes.
- Adding new animals for the new biomes.
- Adding new levels.
- Adding new biomes.

Once again, thank you for your support and feedback! It helps us tremendously in improving the game and keeps us motivated to continue! 🚀

notes.title: PatchNote DEMO v0.7.9.1 - Feedback and Updates
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416658/f7f223409a6f30402c9f3c69391dcf940ecf811e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416658/5b9e9a910e094706efb2a8e1b50373281e0758f9.png[/img][/url]

Thank you all so much for playing our DEMO during the Steam Fest!
My artist partner and I have been working on this first project for 10 months, and we never expected so many people to take an interest in our game.

We recently hit 1,000 wishlists after the Steam Next Fest, which feels like a great milestone for our first experience—but of course, it's just the beginning, and not quite enough to stand out from the crowd.

Either way, we're motivated to keep going! Our goal is to release the game in the next few months if all goes well. We're still deciding whether it'll be a full release or an Early Access version to start.

We’ve been carefully reading all your feedback and have just uploaded a new demo build with several fixes and improvements from the past few days:

🔧 Demo Update Fixes:

- Fixed unreliable crates that couldn’t be lifted properly
- Improved translations
- Fixed a menu bug that prevented changing options
- Corrected platform weight calculations
- Fixed a level design issue in an underground area that made it impossible to complete
- Capped FPS when VSync is disabled to avoid performance issues

🛠 What we're working on next:

- Preventing interactions when you're already holding something
- Fixing cases where you can interact with two things at once if they're too close together
- Adding new levels
- Adding new biomes

Thanks again for your support and feedback. It really helps us shape the game and stay motivated!
